name: Create a link
description: The server sets id, createdAt (the time added) and updatedAt.

example.title: Pozole rojo
example.description: Make the chile sauce a day ahead.

data.title: Pozole rojo
data.description: Make the chile sauce a day ahead.

rules: title and description are trimmed; an empty description is stored as null.
url must be an absolute http(s) URL, otherwise VALIDATION_FAILED on url.
url must not match an existing link's url, otherwise DUPLICATE_URL.
categoryId, when not null, must reference an existing category, otherwise VALIDATION_FAILED on categoryId.
rating must be an integer from 0 to 5; omitted means 0.
